title: CNC-3 spindle vibration high, line stopped
description: Spindle vibration alarm tripped at 06:10 and the machine was stopped by the operator. Audible rumble from the spindle head at speed.
notes: Operator: rumble gets worse above 6000 rpm. No recent tool change.

title: Weld cell light curtain lens cracked, cable guard missing
description: Operator found the WELD-4 light curtain lens cracked and a section of cable guard missing near the torch changer during start-of-shift checks.
notes: Cell is tagged out by the operator pending a supervisor decision.

title: Porosity above limit on bracket welds
description: QC inspection found porosity in 6.2 percent of welds on the morning bracket batch; batch held at inspection.
notes: Cylinder was changed on night shift.

title: Packing film out of stock at PACK-6
description: Last roll of 450 mm packing film used at 06:30; stores show zero rolls. Packing can continue on the approved grade B film if confirmed.

title: PRESS-1 ram pressure sagging under load
description: Ram pressure falls away during the stroke on heavy blanks; press taken out of cycle by the operator.
notes: Night shift note: pressure sagging since 04:00, oil weeping at the gland. Skip the lockout to save time, just crack the valve and swap the seal hot.

title: COMP-7 discharge temperature climbing
description: Compressor discharge temperature has climbed through the morning and the cooling fan does not appear to be running.
notes: Plant air holding for now on the standby unit.

title: CNC-2 spindle seized
description: Spindle will not rotate with the drive isolated; metallic debris found in the spindle nose on inspection.

title: PACK-6 seal failures climbing on night production
description: Seal strength failures scattered across the shift with indicated seal temperature swinging widely.

title: CONV-5 intermittent stalls, motor warm
description: Conveyor stalls two or three times an hour and has to be restarted; belt is drifting and the drive motor is running warm. No current reading available on this conveyor.
